candidate: Original-quality performance update; measured in the local working tree before publication

conditions.execution: Sequential alternating baseline/candidate trials, fresh Chrome per trial
conditions.measurementScope: Initial navigation and the complete six-city sequence, including fixed waits; long-task sums are not initial page load times. Native lazy-loading decisions and resource counts can vary by timing.
conditions.limitations: CPU simulation on this computer, not measurements of the affected computers; GPU and physical mouse latency are not measured. Headless animation frames are not a real display FPS measurement.
